question: 每个大区销量最高的单品是哪个
sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.region,
    p.sku_name,
    SUM(s.qty) AS total_qty,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.region ORDER BY SUM(s.qty) DESC) AS rn
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
  JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
  WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY o.region, p.sku_name
)
SELECT region, sku_name, total_qty AS 销量
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY total_qty DESC

question: 哪些品牌的净销额占比超过百分之十
sql:
WITH brand_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    p.brand AS 品牌,
    SUM(s.net_amount) AS 品牌净销额
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY p.brand
),
total_sales AS (
  SELECT SUM(品牌净销额) AS 总净销额
  FROM brand_sales
)
SELECT 
  b.品牌,
  b.品牌净销额 / t.总净销额 AS 净销额占比
FROM brand_sales b
CROSS JOIN total_sales t
WHERE b.品牌净销额 / t.总净销额 > 0.10
ORDER BY 净销额占比 DESC

question: 有多少家终端的净销额高于所有终端的平均水平
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS 终端数
FROM (
    SELECT s.outlet_id
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY s.outlet_id
    HAVING SUM(s.net_amount) > (
        SELECT SUM(s2.net_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s2.outlet_id), 0)
        FROM fact_sales s2
        JOIN dim_date d2 ON s2.date_key = d2.date_key
        WHERE d2.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    )
) t

question: 2026年8月哪些品类的销量比7月增长了
sql:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.category AS 品类,
        d.year_month AS 年月,
        SUM(s.qty) AS 销量
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
    WHERE d.year_month IN ('2026-07', '2026-08')
    GROUP BY p.category, d.year_month
)
SELECT 
    a.品类
FROM monthly_sales a

question: 2026年各月净销额及占全年的比例

  JOIN dim_dealer dl ON pc.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
  WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
  GROUP BY dl.dealer_name
)
SELECT
  s.dealer_name AS 经销商名称,
  s.promo_net_amount / NULLIF(c.cost_amount, 0) AS 费效比
FROM s
JOIN c USING (dealer_name)
ORDER BY 费效比 DESC
LIMIT 5

question: 华东区在2026年8月的铺市率和动销率分别是多少
sql:
WITH filtered_outlets AS (
    SELECT o.outlet_id
    FROM dim_outlet o
    WHERE o.region = '华东'
      AND o.is_active = TRUE
),
filtered_products AS (
    SELECT p.sku_id
    FROM dim_product p
    WHERE p.is_active = TRUE
),
listed_combos AS (
    SELECT r.outlet_id, r.sku_id
    FROM rel_outlet_sku r
    JOIN filtered_outlets fo ON r.outlet_id = fo.outlet_id
    JOIN filtered_products fp ON r.sku_id = fp.sku_id
    WHERE r.listed_date <= DATE '2026-08-31'
      AND (r.delisted_date IS NULL OR r.delisted_date >= DATE '2026-08-01')
),
sales_combos AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.outlet_id, s.sku_id
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN filtered_outlets fo ON s.outlet_id = fo.outlet_id
    JOIN filtered_products fp ON s.sku_id = fp.sku_id
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.is_new_product THEN lc.outlet_id END)::DOUBLE 
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT fo.outlet_id), 0) AS 新品铺市率,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_combos)::DOUBLE 
    / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM listed_combos), 0) AS 动销率
FROM listed_combos lc
JOIN filtered_outlets fo ON lc.outlet_id = fo.outlet_id
JOIN dim_product p ON lc.sku_id = p.sku_id

question: 2026年8月库存周转天数最长的十个经销商
sql:
WITH inv_monthly AS (
    SELECT 
        i.dealer_id,
        d.year_month,
        SUM(i.qty_on_hand) AS total_qty_on_hand
    FROM fact_inventory i
    JOIN dim_date d ON i.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY i.dealer_id, d.year_month
),
sales_monthly AS (
    SELECT 
        s.dealer_id,
        d.year_month,
        SUM(s.qty) AS total_qty,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.date_key) AS days_with_sales
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY s.dealer_id, d.year_month
)
SELECT 
    dl.dealer_name AS 经销商名称,
    inv.total_qty_on_hand / NULLIF(sales.total_qty / NULLIF(sales.days_with_sales, 0), 0) AS 库存周转天数
FROM inv_monthly inv
LEFT JOIN sales_monthly sales ON inv.dealer_id = sales.dealer_id AND inv.year_month = sales.year_month
JOIN dim_dealer dl ON inv.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
ORDER BY 库存周转天数 DESC
LIMIT 10

question: 2026年8月哪些大区的费效比低于5.5

WITH s AS (

  FROM fact_sales s

  JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
  WHERE s.is_promo AND d.year_month = '2026-08'

),

  JOIN dim_outlet o ON pc.outlet_id = o.outlet_id

)

ORDER BY 费效比

question: 各大区2026年8月净销额相比去年同期的增长率
sql:
WITH sales AS (
    SELECT 
        dl.region,
        d.year_month,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_dealer dl ON s.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY dl.region, d.year_month
)
SELECT 
    current.region AS 大区,
    (current.net_amount - previous.net_amount) / NULLIF(previous.net_amount, 0) AS 同比增长率
FROM sales current
LEFT JOIN sales previous 
    ON current.region = previous.region 
    AND previous.year_month = '2025-08'
WHERE current.year_month = '2026-08'
ORDER BY 大区
LIMIT 10

question: 各渠道2026年8月的单店产出相比去年同期的变化
sql:
WITH current_period AS (
    SELECT 
        o.channel,
        SUM(s.net_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.outlet_id), 0) AS current_output
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY o.channel
),
last_year_period AS (
    SELECT 
        o.channel,
        SUM(s.net_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.outlet_id), 0) AS last_year_output
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2025-08'
    GROUP BY o.channel
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(c.channel, l.channel) AS 渠道,
    COALESCE(c.current_output, 0) - COALESCE(l.last_year_output, 0) AS 单店产出变化
FROM current_period c
FULL JOIN last_year_period l ON c.channel = l.channel
ORDER BY 单店产出变化 DESC
LIMIT 10

question: 2026年上半年的费效比比2025年下半年高多少
sql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT d.year_month, SUM(s.net_amount) AS amt
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE s.is_promo AND d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY 1
),
c AS (
  SELECT d.year_month, SUM(pc.cost_amount) AS cost
  FROM fact_promo_cost pc
  JOIN dim_date d ON pc.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY 1
),
combined AS (
  SELECT s.year_month, s.amt / NULLIF(c.cost, 0) AS 费效比,
         CASE WHEN s.year_month >= '2026-01' THEN '2026H1' ELSE '2025H2' END AS period
  FROM s JOIN c USING (year_month)
)
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026H1' THEN 费效比 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2025H2' THEN 费效比 END) AS 费效比差值
FROM combined
